First-timer FAQs

How many days do I need in Tampa Bay?

Two days cover downtown, Ybor and one big attraction. Three to four days let you add a beach day and a day trip without rushing.

Do I need a car?

Not for a downtown-based trip — the fare-free TECO Streetcar, Riverwalk and water taxi link the core sights. You'll want a car (or rideshare) for Busch Gardens, the beaches and day trips.

When is Gasparilla?

The main Pirate Fest and parade land on the last Saturday of January most years — January 30 in 2027. Book hotels early; downtown fills up.

What's the one food I can't miss?

A pressed Tampa-style Cuban sandwich — with salami, the way Ybor City made it. Add a café con leche and a guava pastry for the full tradition.

I'm cruising from Tampa — any tips?

Arrive a day early and stay near the port: downtown, Channel District and Ybor City hotels are all minutes from the terminals. Your boarding documents name your terminal (2, 3 or 6) and your check-in time, and official port parking sits across from Terminal 3 and beside Terminal 6. See the Cruises section for the lines, ships and routes sailing from Tampa.

Is Tampa Bay good for kids?

Yes — the aquarium, Glazer Children's Museum, ZooTampa and Busch Gardens are all built for families, and the beaches have calm, shallow water.

Start with one idea. Leave with a full itinerary.
